newsitem.title: CHINA: China mine explosion kills 28, two missing.
newsitem.headline: China mine explosion kills 28, two missing.

text.p: A gas explosion is feared to have killed 30 coal miners in China's Inner Mongolia region.
The blast ripped through the Tongda mine in Wuhai City at 5.40 p.m. last Monday while 30 workers were underground, the Inner Mongolia Daily reported in an edition seen in Beijing on Saturday.
Emergency teams had recovered 28 bodies by the weekend and two men still missing were unlikely to be found alive, an official at rescue headquarters said by telephone from on Saturday.
The cause of the explosion was still under investigation, he said

Explosions and other accidents kill up to 10,000 Chinese miners a year, mainly at badly run village pits. The government has vowed to sack directors of mines in which accidents kill 10 or more people.
Gas explosions have already killed 31 this month at a coal mine in the eastern province of Shandong and 12 workers at a private mine in Guizhou province in the south-west.
